title: WendSelect
description: A labeled, single-select dropdown with optional help text. Renders a button trigger and a Floating UI-positioned option panel; consumers slot in wend-option children.

x-wend-slots.name: (default)
x-wend-slots.description: wend-option elements this select can choose between.

label.description: The select's label text. Can be an empty string for a label-less select.

value.description: Value of the currently selected wend-option child.

placeholder.description: Text shown in the trigger when no option is selected.

help-text.description: Supplementary message shown below the field, e.g. a validation message. Can be an empty string to render nothing.

show-help-text.description: Whether the help text is rendered.

state.description: Validation state of the field. Drives the field's border color and the help text's tone.

disabled.description: Disables the select and every wend-option child.

required.description: Marks the select as required. Renders a marker after the label and sets aria-required on the trigger.

name.description: Name submitted for this select when part of a form.
